title: AgentEval Agentic Benchmark Result
$comment: v1 revisions. 0.43: the status enums gained ERROR (a check the verdict rests on produced no verdict) and SKIPPED (nothing measured). Widening only: every document written before still validates, so the $id keeps v1; a consumer that handles only PASS/WARN/FAIL must handle the two new values.

preset.description: The benchmark preset used for this evaluation run.

subject.description: Identity of the agent or workflow that was evaluated.

sourceRunId.description: Run ID of the benchmark run that produced the composite tree.

sourceManifestHash.description: Content hash of the source run manifest, for audit trail integrity.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp when this result document was generated.

compositeTree.description: Recursive EvalResult tree produced by the benchmark runner. Validated separately by eval-result.schema.json.

overallStatus.description: Overall verdict: a measured PASS, WARN or FAIL; ERROR when a check the verdict rests on produced no verdict; SKIPPED when nothing was measured.

perCategory.description: Category-level roll-ups keyed by category string.

perEvaluator.description: Evaluator-level roll-ups keyed by metric key.

criticalFindings.description: Leaf EvalResult nodes with severity=critical that did not pass, ordered worst-first.

items.description: EvalResult for a critical-severity evaluator that failed.

recommendations.description: Short remediation strings for failed evaluators, ordered by evaluator key.

disclaimer.description: Required disclaimer that this result is not a compliance attestation.

attestation.description: Tooling and judge configuration metadata for reproducibility.

agentEvalVersion.description: AgentEval assembly version that generated this result.

promptVersions.description: Map of prompt template key to version string.
